page: Microsoft Azure F48alds_v7 is a compute-optimized virtual machine powered by the x86_64 AMD EPYC 9V45 processor under Microsoft Hyper-V. The configuration provides 48 physical cores and 48 vCPUs with a single thread per core, operating at clock speeds up to 4.5 GHz. System memory totals 96.0 GB, establishing a compute-focused 2.0 GB per vCPU allocation. Local storage includes an integrated 5,669 GB NVMe SSD array, while graphical processing units are absent.

Benchmark measurements indicate top-decile performance across compute-intensive tasks, including multi-core stress testing and single-core throughput. The architecture integrates AVX-512 vector extensions, AVX-VNNI, and cryptographic hardware acceleration, yielding high throughput in multi-threaded bzip3 decompression and gzip compression. Memory operations register top-tier performance on small cached blocks and strong throughput on uncached 256 MB block transfers. Database and key-value benchmarks show high throughput, with Redis recording over 131 million SET operations per second.

The 2:1 memory-to-core ratio represents an operational tradeoff, trading memory capacity for dense processing power. This balance offers strong cost efficiency for CPU-bound pipelines by minimizing the allocation of unused RAM while pairing processing capacity with high-capacity local NVMe storage. Microsoft Azure F48alds_v7 is suited for compute-heavy batch processing, code compilation, continuous integration pipelines, static web serving, and localized caching layers.
description: Microsoft Azure F48alds_v7 is a compute-optimized virtual machine designed for high-throughput computational workloads. Powered by an x86_64 AMD EPYC 9V45 processor clocked at up to 4.5 GHz, it supplies 48 dedicated physical cores with a 1:1 vCPU-to-thread layout. The instance includes 96.0 GB of memory, reflecting a 2.0 GB per core ratio, and bundles 5,669 GB of local NVMe SSD storage without discrete GPUs. Benchmark results place the server in the top tier for multi-core compute tests, data compression routines, and Redis key-value operations. The system incorporates AVX-512 vector execution, VAES cryptography, and robust cache throughput. Due to its lean memory profile and dense NVMe storage, the instance delivers efficient compute capacity for processing-intensive tasks, making it suited for CI/CD compilation, batch analytics, compression pipelines, and high-speed temporary caching.
